evidence.observation: T701 reads 348.271 °C while T702 is 48.795 °C, T703 is 38.637 °C and T712 is 26.617 °C: a pronounced reboiler-to-column temperature discrepancy.
The discrepancy persists: T701 is 349.763 °C versus T702 54.253 °C, T703 44.341 °C and T712 37.424 °C; these readings warrant verification rather than assuming normal heat-up.
System pressure remains near 300 mbar (299.803); differential pressures are -0.257 and 1.918 mbar, without a sustained pressure rise identifying a leak or blockage.
Reflux is 0.574 L/h and distillate flow is 0.005 L/h; flow measurements do not establish product composition.

args.missing_evidence: Independent reboiler temperature measurement, T701 calibration and tag/unit verification, and protocol temperature limits are needed to distinguish a measurement fault from real overheating. Feed identity, operating targets and product composition are needed to assess separation.
